Your to-do app with automated scripture publishing, audio narration, and full Bible reading is live and saved!

### 🌐 View Your App
👉 **[Open GraceTasks Web App](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/6f5af5d3-8c5e-476f-873e-d67bd50c4df5/115bd8f5b7b6bdb4cecf7430/)**

---

### What Has Been Built

#### 1. ⏰ Automated Screen Publishing at Your Set Times
- **Set Particular Times**: Add any custom time of day (e.g., `07:00`, `12:00`, `18:30`, `21:30`) via the **Publishing Schedule** tab.
- **⚡ In 1 Minute (Quick Test)**: One-click button that schedules an alert 60 seconds from now so you can immediately see the automatic publishing in action.
- **Quick Presets**: Single-click buttons for Morning (07:00), Midday (12:00), Afternoon (15:00), Evening (18:30), and Bedtime (21:30).
- **Live Real-Time Countdown**: The top navigation bar displays a live countdown timer (*"Next Verse in: 12m 45s at 10:00 AM"*).
- **"Publish Verse Now" Button**: Trigger an instant screen publication anytime.
- **Sacred Chime & Desktop Notifications**: Plays a gentle crystal chime when the verse publishes, with optional desktop notification support if the browser is in the background.

#### 2. 🔊 Audio Version (Listen Option)
- **Natural Voice Narration**: Speaks scripture passages using clear, natural voice cadence.
- **Playback Controls**: Play, pause, resume, and adjust speech speeds (0.8x gentle, 1.0x normal, 1.2x brisk).
- **Animated Audio Waveforms**: Visualizer waves animate during speech playback.
- **Auto-Speak Verse Toggle**: Option to automatically speak the verse aloud the moment it publishes to your screen.
- **Peaceful Ambient Pad**: Built-in meditative background synthesizer (Web Audio API) you can toggle on or off with volume control in Settings.

#### 3. 📖 "Read Through All" (Full Bible Reader)
- **"Read Through All (Full Chapter)"**: When a verse publishes to your screen, click this button to open the full chapter with the published verse highlighted.
- **Complete Scripture Access**: Browse all 66 books of the Bible (Genesis to Revelation) with fast chapter navigation.
- **Continuous Chapter Audio**: Click the play button on the audio bar to listen to the entire chapter continuously, with real-time verse-by-verse highlighting and auto-scrolling.
- **Interactive Verses**: Click any verse in the reader to listen to it, save it to your favorites, or attach it to your to-do list.
- **Navigation Controls**: Previous Chapter (◀), Next Chapter (▶), and "🎲 Inspiring Chapter" shortcuts (Psalm 23, John 14, Romans 8, 1 Corinthians 13, Psalm 91, Isaiah 40, etc.).
- **Font Size Adjuster**: A- and A+ buttons for comfortable reading.

#### 4. ✅ Full-Featured To-Do App
- **Task Management**: Create tasks with title, category (🕊️ *Faith & Prayer*, 💼 *Work & Study*, 🌱 *Personal*, 🏡 *Family*, 🌿 *Health*), priority, due date (with quick "Today" button), and optional notes.
- **Scripture Integration**: Click the sparkle icon on any task to attach encouraging Bible verses, or click "Add to Tasks" from any published verse modal.
- **Task Progress Bar**: Live progress tracking showing Total, In Progress, Completed, and percentage completion.
- **Productivity Filters**: Filter tasks by All, Active, Done, Faith, High Priority, or Due Today, plus real-time search and "Clear Completed" button.
- **Completion Celebration**: Completing a task plays a harmonic completion chime and triggers celebratory confetti.
- **Task Editing**: Edit any task's title, notes, priority, category, or due date at any time.
